notes: JSON results that include saved.path are enriched with artifacts[] descriptors; cliNextActions[] only carries non-duplicate executable follow-ups.
Large or sensitive raw payloads stay in local artifacts; read bounded paths with browser-pilot artifact.

tabId.description: Compatibility target: numeric tabId or stable tabHandle string. Prefer targetRef/tabHandle from browser_tabs list; omit to use the selected active tab.

targetRef.description: Stable target reference from browser_tabs list/create (tabHandle). Preferred over numeric tabId because it survives unambiguous in-place tab replacement.

flags.name: tabId
flags.description: Compatibility target: numeric tabId or stable tabHandle string. Prefer targetRef/tabHandle from browser_tabs list; omit to use the selected active tab.

flags.name: targetRef
flags.description: Stable target reference from browser_tabs list/create (tabHandle). Preferred over numeric tabId because it survives unambiguous in-place tab replacement.
